Limits and rates are all PRIMARY-sourced: Basic Healthcare Sum S$79,000 and the interest floors and extra-interest tiers from the MOH/CPF release 'CPF interest rates from 1 Jan to 31 Mar 2026 and Basic Healthcare Sum for 2026'; Full Retirement Sum S$220,400 from the MOM factsheet 'Basic Retirement Sums for CPF Members Reaching Age 55 from 2023 to 2027'; contribution and allocation rates from the CPF Board PDFs. All read 13 Sep 2026.

The expected figures below were recomputed in a SEPARATE Python implementation written from those published rules, and agree with the app to the dollar. IMPORTANT: this verifies that the app faithfully implements the published rules; it is NOT a comparison against CPF's own projection calculator. Known simplifications that remain: the BHS is held flat (CPF raises it most years), and housing withdrawals, top-ups and CPF LIFE are excluded.

cases.note: age 32 to 55, 7,000 salary, 2.5% growth - MediSave caps at the BHS
age 50 to 60 - crosses 55, so the RA is formed up to the FRS
age 30 to 40, flat salary - MediSave still below the BHS
